SMTO-CFG-0019 — SMTO got new-chat settings for a conversation that already exists

GUID: 245d066b-cc90-46f5-b3d7-94ed2f1b451c
Slug: composer-pending-scope-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • Choices meant only for starting a brand-new conversation, such as Parallel execution or Background activities, were sent with a conversation that already exists. SMTO didn't start the task or change any settings.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page and open the conversation from the Conversations pane. The page was still treating this conversation as a new, unsaved chat; reloading loads it as the existing conversation.
  2. To change those choices for this conversation, use Options or Agent Checks above the message box, then send your message again. For an existing conversation, these choices are saved through those controls, not sent with the message.

What success looks like

  • Your message is sent, and Options shows the choices you picked for this conversation.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. If a tool or script sent the message, tell its owner to leave out new-chat choices when it names an existing conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task admission rejected the submission because conversation_policy_defaults (pending new-conversation scheduling policies) were supplied together with an existing conversation_id.

What this means

  • Submission supplies pending conversation_policy_defaults together with an existing conversation ID. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Submission supplies pending conversation_policy_defaults together with an existing conversation ID.

How to diagnose it

  • Check whether the request creates a new conversation or edits an existing one.

How to fix it

  • Omit conversation_policy_defaults when conversation_id is set. Change an existing conversation's scheduling policies through their own endpoints (parallel-execution, background-activities, dependency-scheduling, resource-scheduling) with scope conversation, then resubmit.
  • Use the existing conversation policy editor; pending policies apply only to a new conversation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Existing conversation policy edits use their owning editor; only new conversations receive pending defaults.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
